svg.title: Airway RNA-seq expression heatmap
svg.desc: Top 18 most variable genes across eight airway smooth muscle samples, using row z-scores of log2 normalized counts. Four paired donor samples, untreated and dexamethasone treated.
svg.text: Top 18 variable genes · log₂ normalized counts, row z-scored · GSE52778
Color shows relative expression within each gene, not significance.
